errors.text_span: der rechte Balken in Dunkelviolettt mit diagonalen Streifen steht für „60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten“
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly claims that the purple bars representing "60 % des Medianlohns der Vollzeitbeschäftigten" generally have diagonal stripes. In the figure, only the bars for the years 2024 and 2025 have this striped pattern; the bars from 2015 to 2023 are solid purple.

errors.text_span: und es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung bestimmter Balken
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there is no visual highlighting. The purple bars for the years 2024 and 2025 are visually highlighted with a diagonal stripe pattern, differentiating them from the solid-colored bars of the previous years.
There is a typo in the word "Dunkelviolett" (purple), which is spelled with an extra 't'.
